biggest_catch: Gift cards are 'digital goods,' so you pay the full stack: 8% commission + fixed fee + 2% partner + 2% digital — about 12-13% off your listing price before payout.
catches: Total fee on a digital gift card ≈ 12% + fixed fee ($0.10-$0.80); a $90 sale nets ~$78.40 — worse than most dedicated gift card sites.
ID verification (phone + government ID) required before you can sell.
Funds sit in Gameflip Wallet until you withdraw; payout rails have their own fees/limits (see Payout Guide).
Buyer must confirm delivery before funds release (auto-release up to 72h) — payment is not instant at sale.
You must keep the store receipt for at least 6 months as proof of legitimacy.
Niche-brand cards have thin buyer demand; gaming/entertainment cards sell fastest.

eligibility: 18+ (ID verification required); gift cards with no expiry dates or fees; must be redeemable directly with the merchant online; regional restrictions must be stated
maximize: Price a few percent under the lowest competing listing for your brand so yours sells first — speed matters because the fee is fixed regardless. Keep your store receipt for 6 months (Gameflip's own rule) so you win any legitimacy dispute. Deliver digital codes promptly so the buyer confirms fast and funds release sooner. If you sell often, check their subscription plans, which officially lower fees for high-volume sellers. Gameflip's edge is gaming/entertainment cards (Xbox, PlayStation, Steam) — sell those here, sell mainstream retail cards on CardCash/Raise instead.

s6.note: 5 steps: verify ID, list, sell, buyer confirms, withdraw.

steps: Create a Gameflip account and complete ID verification (phone + government ID)
List the gift card under the correct brand category with accurate balance and redemption instructions
Set your price below face value (check competing listings; gaming cards move fastest)
Buyer purchases; deliver the digital code (or ship the physical card)
Buyer confirms receipt (or auto-confirms within 72h); fees deducted; funds land in your Gameflip Wallet
Withdraw from your wallet via PayPal or other payout rails
timing: Funds released to Gameflip Wallet after buyer confirms delivery (up to 72h auto-release); withdrawal timing/fees per official Payout Guide
who_pays: The buyer pays through Gameflip; funds land in your Gameflip Wallet after the buyer confirms delivery (or auto-release, up to 72 hours).
who_qualifies: 18+ with ID verification (phone + government ID) required before you can sell. Cards must have no expiry dates or fees, be redeemable directly with the merchant online, and any regional restrictions must be stated. Keep your store receipt for at least 6 months as proof of legitimacy.
work_available: Gameflip's marketplace is active and open to verified sellers.
what_gets_accepted: Your listing must be an accurately described, legitimate card; the sale completes when the buyer confirms delivery. Cards that can't be verified as legitimate are rejected.
costs_and_unpaid_time: About 12% plus a fixed $0.10–$0.80 fee on digital gift cards, per Gameflip's official fee schedule; payout rails (PayPal/crypto) have their own fees and limits per the Payout Guide. Unpaid time goes to listing, waiting for the buyer to confirm, and keeping your receipt.
when_cash_arrives: Funds hit your Gameflip Wallet after the buyer confirms delivery, auto-releasing within 72 hours at the latest. Withdrawal to PayPal or crypto follows the timing in Gameflip's Payout Guide.
